pages.text: A balanced fertilizer that adds small amounts of all three nutrients.$(br2)Nitrogen (N): +1$(br)Phosphorus (P): +1$(br)Potassium (K): +1
Bootstrap recipe: 2x Oak Leaves + Hemp Seeds + Dirt → 1 Compost. Use this to make your first batch!
Once you have compost, use this recipe to double your supply: Leaves + Hemp Seeds + Leaves tag + Compost → 2 Compost.
